{{Locations|Mantis Controlled Sector|Mantis Homeworlds|LRSmap=noship|unique=true}}


The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following: 
*''A derelict and still smoking Mantis vessel floats by. The battle must have been recent; its surviving crew beam aboard. Prepare for a fight!''
*''Your world, all of a sudden, changes. The Mantis are on board your ship.''
*''You hear a grating rattle and a soft clicking. You reach for your pistol.''
**<span style="color:red">2-4 mantis boarders</span> beam aboard your ship.

==Notes==
This event is called "MANTIS_BOARDERS" in the datafiles.
[[Category:Boarding hazard]]
